title: SGP Lab Definition Schema
description: Schema for the canonical lab YAML format (one lab per file). See docs/CONTENT-PIPELINE.md for the full pipeline.

id.description: Lab identifier. Must match the directory name (e.g. lab-1, hello-world).

tags.description: Topic tags for filtering and discovery.

objectives.description: Learning objectives displayed to the student.

setup.description: Optional commands to run before this lab starts. Resets container state.

command.description: Shell command to execute inside the container.

environment.description: Reference to an environment definition file (e.g. 'docker-basic' → environments/docker-basic.yaml).

tasks.description: Ordered list of tasks the student must complete. Omit for a skeleton lab (the worker emits a warning, not an error).

required_tasks.description: 'all' or a list of task IDs that must be completed.

task.description: A single task the student must complete.

title.description: Optional short title for the task.

description.description: Optional longer description of what the task requires.

prompt.description: The question or instruction shown to the student.

type.description: Task type. multiple_choice: student picks from options. terminal_action: student runs a command in the terminal. port_check: student verifies a published port/path. file_check: student creates or modifies a file.

options.description: Static answer options (for multiple_choice with fixed options).

options_source.description: For multiple_choice. Set to 'dynamic' when options are generated at runtime.

validation.description: How to check if the task is complete.

command.description: Shell command to run inside the container.

execution_user.description: Optional: user to run the validation command as. Use 'root' for administrative checks or 'student' to validate student-session capabilities. If omitted the platform may default to 'student'.

expected_output.description: Expected output to match against. Omit for dynamic multiple_choice.

expected_exit_code.description: Optional: expected exit code from the validation command (0 for success).

match_type.description: How to compare command output to expected_output.

script.description: Path to a validation script (alternative to command + expected_output). Script must exit 0 for pass.

path.description: File path inside the container (for file_check, or port_check).

contains.description: String the file must contain (for file_check).

port.description: Port number the container must be listening on (for port_check).

hint.description: A guiding hint. Ask a question, don't give the answer.
